title: Higer Bus 45 Day Service Boosts Tanzania Transport
summary: Suzhou King Long carried out a 45-day special service operation in Tanzania covering maintenance, technical support, customer training and spare parts guarantee for more than 400 Higer buses.
content:
Higer · Global Imprint | 45-day East Africa special service, interpreting the brand power of Made in China

Suzhou King Long is using service as a lever to build a new ecosystem for Chinese bus brands in Tanzania. From the main urban roads of Dar es Salaam to the long-distance trunk lines leading to Dodoma and Arusha, more than 400 Higer buses have become a moving landscape on the East African continent. This profound trust stems from Suzhou King Long's firm practice of the philosophy that "product delivery is only the starting point, while full life-cycle service is the real commitment."

Recently, Suzhou King Long's Overseas Customer Service Department organized overseas service engineers, service technicians, and local teams to carry out a 45-day special service operation in Tanzania. They went deep into the front lines of vehicle operations in Tanzania, focusing on four core areas: vehicle maintenance, technical support, customer training, and spare parts guarantee. With professional, efficient, and pragmatic services, they precisely addressed customer pain points and deeply planted the essence of "Chinese Service" in the African soil.

The Higer after-sales service team measured this "Eden of Africa" with wheels and footsteps. Undeterred by challenges such as the local heat, vast territory, and inconvenient transportation, they traveled between core cities like Dar es Salaam and Arusha and their surrounding areas, covering major passenger transport routes in Tanzania. The team adopted a one-stop service model of "on-site inspection + fixed-point maintenance + on-site training" to conduct comprehensive "physical examinations" for hundreds of Higer buses operating locally. They focused on troubleshooting key components such as engines, chassis, braking systems, air conditioning systems, and electrical equipment, meticulously recording vehicle operating conditions to ensure every vehicle is put into operation in its best state with ultimate craftsmanship.

Spare parts supply is a key link in overseas service capability. Addressing local parts storage issues, the Higer after-sales service team conducted front-line research on demands, systematically sorted out core parts lists, assisted distributors in optimizing warehouse layouts, and urgently deployed commonly used wear parts and key components. By opening up supply channels, they achieved 72-hour efficient delivery for common parts. Meanwhile, Higer service engineers proactively promoted the usage standards of genuine parts to customers, building a defense line for vehicle operation safety and reliability from the source.

This special service operation is not only the practical implementation of technical support but also a concentrated reflection of the comprehensive capabilities of Suzhou King Long's overseas service system. From the historical monument of the TAZARA Railway to the Higer buses now galloping on Tanzanian highways, "Made in China" is integrating into local development with a new posture of greater warmth and depth. As a firm practitioner of the "Belt and Road" initiative, Suzhou King Long is accelerating its leap from "selling products" to "building an ecosystem"—by establishing local service stations, deploying long-term personnel, and conducting regular customer visits, it is building sustainable localized service capabilities, allowing "Chinese Brands" to truly take root and grow in overseas markets.

The 45-day special service operation earned heartfelt recognition from many Tanzanian customers. After the service ended, one customer gave a thumbs-up and sincerely said in Chinese: "I love Higer." This simple and sincere sentence became the most touching footnote of this operation. In the future, Suzhou King Long Higer Bus will continue to escort this land of hope with reliable products and thoughtful services, writing a brand-new chapter for Chinese bus brands on the China-Africa path of the new era.
